phase: Phase 1 (GA readiness for opt-in CBraMod-200D Tier-2)

verdict.rationale: Phase 0 closed the M13 pgvector gap (live RPC validated, CBraMod R5 0.5269 ~ M13 0.5273). All 7 mandatory code-level gates pass with live evidence. However, production-operational gates (browser/WASM runtime, signed-artifact SHA re-verification under real auth, rate-limit/concurrency against a real Supabase edge stack, API-contract under real JWT auth) could not be fully exercised in the local environment and are marked INCONCLUSIVE. CBraMod must remain opt-in only; DEFAULT_PREFERRED unchanged.
verdict.promotion_rule: Smallest opt-in promotion ONLY after the 4 INCONCLUSIVE operational gates pass in a production-like environment. Never DEFAULT_PREFERRED.

evidence.note: Mocked ort runtime + mocked NeuralVectorIndex; measures route handler + shared singleton concurrency, not native forward parallelisation.

status_codes.400: bad input (non-multipart, missing file, missing sampleRate, empty)
status_codes.422: magic-number mismatch / parse error / empty signal / too-short

response_fields_missing: retrieval_status (structured indexing/retrieval status; info present as counts+error string only)

evidence.security_definer_note: match_foundation_embeddings is SECURITY DEFINER and bypasses table RLS; cross-user isolation depends on the route passing the authenticated userId as filter_user_id (neural-index.ts:195, foundation.ts:135/235/299). Verified in code + regression test.

evidence.rollback_simulation: Static isolation analysis (no production edits performed)

pre_existing_failures: src/lib/ai/inference/__tests__/engine-lifecycle.test.ts (InferenceEngine.getAdapter/cacheSize is not a function — P3 API mismatch)
evidence.typecheck: 46 pre-existing errors in vite-plugins/test-harness.ts (none from Phase-1 files)

gates.name: Browser/WASM runtime execution
gates.reason: CBraMod is wasmCompatible:false (DFT/ReduceL2 ops); runs only on onnxruntime-node server-side. Browser/WASM execution path not exercised (no real Supabase edge runtime + native addon available).
gates.next_step: Execute against a Node-capable server runtime with onnxruntime-node installed.

gates.name: Signed-artifact SHA re-verification under real auth
gates.reason: SHA-256 + size gate verified in-process (foundation.server.ts:163-172) and tested (Gate 1). The T-016 browser-compatible signed-artifact delivery path (runtime-verifier.ts) was not exercised for CBraMod (server-only path).
gates.next_step: Verify the full fetch+verify+cache path under the production edge runtime.

gates.name: Rate-limit/concurrency against real Supabase stack
gates.reason: Live-tested against a throwaway local Postgres (real check_rate_limit RPC, deterministic boundary proven). The production Supabase edge runtime (distributed multi-isolate rate counter) was not tested.
gates.next_step: Load-test against a real Supabase project with the auth.users + rate_limits migration applied.

gates.name: API-contract under real JWT auth
gates.reason: Auth + 4xx/424 contract asserted via route-direct tests with mocked authenticateRequest. Real JWT verification (auth.uid() with a signed Supabase token) not exercised.
gates.next_step: Exercise POST /api/eeg/embed/foundation with a real Supabase anon/service-role JWT against a deployed instance.

production_fixes_applied.change: Added foundationRequestsTotal/ErrorsTotal/BytesTotal/EmbedMs registrations (additive; route referenced them but they were undefined, crashing every request).
Added 'export' keyword to finalize() (was private, but foundation.server.ts imports it).
NeuralVectorIndex now honors tableName/matchRpc/matchRpcExact options (was hardcoded to 'embeddings'/'match_embeddings'); Tier-1 defaults preserved.
